about: Conditional decisions, plus proposals that were rejected. Rejected ideas must not become action items.
lines: mic
Two decisions today: the hosting move and the vendor for SMS.
mic
On hosting, we only move to the new cloud region if the load test passes at two thousand concurrent users.
tab
The load test is scheduled for the fourteenth. Ravi will run it.
mic
For SMS, someone suggested switching to the cheaper vendor, but we rejected that because their delivery rate in Sabah is poor.
mic
So we stay with the current SMS vendor for this year.
tab
What about the free trial they offered? Could we use it for internal alerts only?
mic
No, let's not. Keep it simple, one vendor.
mic
Mei Ling, please ask finance to renew the SMS contract before it expires at the end of March.
tab
Will do, I'll send the request this week.
mic
One more: if the region move happens, we freeze deployments for that weekend.
